'''Greater demon ash lords''' are monsters released with [[The Zamorakian Undercity]]. The demons in the elite dungeon are immune to stun and poison, whereas their [[Greater demon ash lord|Wilderness counterparts]] have less health and are susceptible to both stun and poison.

These monsters are capable of pathing around obstacles to reach the player and can deal immense amounts of damage with their magic attacks. They may be killed in place of a [[greater demon]] task for more slayer experience.

==Trivia==
* This type of greater demon used to possess the [[Strong guard (status)|Strong guard]] status, which made the players' attacks incapable of missing and made their [[Ability damage|damage]] dependent on their [[Hit chance|accuracy]]; this was effectively replaced by the damage potential system on [[4 March]] [[2024]].
